status: PROPOSED synthetic and physical QA; NOT EXECUTED

items.query: WASAPI DATA_DISCONTINUITY SILENT TIMESTAMP_ERROR combinations and BUFFER_EMPTY
acceptance: Each flag retains its own meaning; SILENT alone does not imply glitch
TIMESTAMP_ERROR never establishes timing PASS; empty packet does not reuse stale timestamps

items.query: Duplex capture and render endpoints have independent clock frequencies and QPC samples
acceptance: Normalize IAudioClock position using GetFrequency and QPC to 100 ns
No raw position comparison across endpoints; shared-only IAudioClock2 respected

items.query: Late packet after Stop Reset or endpoint invalidation races with new capture generation
acceptance: Old generation packet cannot update current measurement
Reset begins new epoch; Stop/Start without Reset does not imply position zero

items.query: Synthetic tests pass but no physical USB capture evidence exists
acceptance: Report DOC_REVIEW/SYNTHETIC separately from hardware PASS
Physical claim requires device identity, mode, actual period, duration, sample format, artifacts and hashes
